verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-protection SaaS that processes order and customer data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion API, or data-erasure workflow. The sensitive-data rejection layer and test teams excluded from model learning are adjacent data-handling controls, and cancelling a guarantee changes coverage rather than deleting data, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
